explanation: Adding or changing a dataset follows the same steps. From main: a CI test fails when author-validation ledgers are committed without regenerating validation-records.generated.json, a step the workflow already required in the maintainer checkout. From this branch: explorerStore.ts splits its one error banner into a resource half (metadata, QC) and a track half, so a track load clears only a track failure when it starts and a metadata or QC failure keeps its Retry.
